findings.summary: Stale field-surface documentation for the retired `parked` field: LINE_STATE_FIELDS still lists "parked" and the list_line_states/get_line_state docstrings still name it in the returned field surface, while FleetStateView.lines() no longer emits the key (R6 §7.2.4). The constant is unused (nothing projects through it) and both the :7494 and line-state MCP payloads are correctly parked-free, so this is API-documentation residue on a live read-only tool, not a field re-emission.

Stray `ited` alternative in the B2 dead-protocol count regex (`agent\.run\.(started|ited|exited)`) of the read-only B-3 verify script. It can only over-count PRESENT (fail-safe direction — it can never mask a residue) and the script is not yet executed against production, but it is worth tidying before the B-3 escalation package is filed.
